visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Count Once, Subtract for the Rest
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Both counters are updated with separate if statements that repeat the same test. Count only the evens and derive the odds. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Every element is either even or odd, so odds = total - evens. That removes the duplicated test, the magic number 8 and the unclear single-letter names.
